java.lang.Object

**All Implemented Interfaces:**
java.lang.Cloneable
```
public class CompatibilityOptions implements Cloneable
```

Contiene le opzioni di compatibilità (cioè le preferenze dell'utente inserite nella scheda **Compatibility** della finestra di dialogo **Options** in Microsoft Word).

Per saperne di più, visita l'articolo della documentazione [ Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility ][Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility].

 **Examples:** 

Mostra come ottimizzare il documento per diverse versioni di Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 /// 
 /// Groups all flags in a document's compatibility options object by state, then prints each group.
 ///

     addOptionName(options.getSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning(), "SwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getTransparentMetafiles(), "TransparentMetafiles", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6(), "TruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUICompat97To2003(), "UICompat97To2003", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUlTrailSpace(), "UlTrailSpace", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUnderlineTabInNumList(), "UnderlineTabInNumList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(), "UseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAnsiKerningPairs(), "UseAnsiKerningPairs", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseFELayout(), "UseFELayout", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseNormalStyleForList(), "UseNormalStyleForList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUsePrinterMetrics(), "UsePrinterMetrics", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells(), "UseSingleBorderforContiguousCells", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getUseWord97LineBreakRules(), "UseWord97LineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPJustification(), "WPJustification", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPSpaceWidth(), "WPSpaceWidth", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWrapTrailSpaces(), "WrapTrailSpaces", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");
     for (String optionName : disabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }
```

Mostra come impostare una specifica di conformità OOXML a cui aderire per un documento salvato.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 // If we configure compatibility options to comply with Microsoft Word 2003,
 // inserting an image will define its shape using VML.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2003);
 builder.insertImage(getImageDir() + "Transparent background logo.png");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.VML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());

 // The "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard does not support VML shapes.
 // If we set the "Compliance" property of the SaveOptions object to "OoxmlCompliance.Iso29500_2008_Strict",
 // any document we save while passing this object will have to follow that standard.
 OoxmlSaveOptions saveOptions = new OoxmlSaveOptions();
 saveOptions.setCompliance(OoxmlCompliance.ISO_29500_2008_STRICT);
 saveOptions.setSaveFormat(SaveFormat.DOCX);

 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx", saveOptions);

 // Our saved document defines the shape using DML to adhere to the "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard.
 doc = new Document(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.DML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());
 
```

Mostra come allineare verticalmente il contenuto di testo di una casella di testo.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 Shape shape = builder.insertShape(ShapeType.TEXT_BOX, 200.0, 200.0);

 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Top" to
 // align the text in this text box with the top side of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Middle" to
 // align the text in this text box to the center of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Bottom" to
 // align the text in this text box to the bottom of the shape.
 shape.getTextBox().setVerticalAnchor(verticalAnchor);

 builder.moveTo(shape.getFirstParagraph());
 builder.write("Hello world!");

 // The vertical aligning of text inside text boxes is available from Microsoft Word 2007 onwards.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2007);
 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "Shape.VerticalAnchor.docx");
 
```

## Metodi

| Metodo | Descrizione |
| --- | --- |
| [getAdjustLineHeightInTable()](#getAdjustLineHeightInTable) | Aggiungi la spaziatura della griglia del documento alle righe nelle celle della tabella. |
| [getAlignTablesRowByRow()](#getAlignTablesRowByRow) | Allinea le righe della tabella in modo indipendente. |
| [getAllowSpaceOfSameStyleInTable()](#getAllowSpaceOfSameStyleInTable) | Consenti la spaziatura contestuale dei paragrafi nelle tabelle. |
| [getApplyBreakingRules()](#getApplyBreakingRules) | Utilizza le regole di interruzione di riga legacy per Etiopico e Amarico. |
| [getAutoSpaceLikeWord95()](#getAutoSpaceLikeWord95) | Emula la spaziatura a larghezza intera dei caratteri di Word 95. |
| [getAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell()](#getAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell) | Consenti alle colonne della tabella di superare le larghezze preferite delle celle costituenti. |
| [getBalanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth()](#getBalanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth) | Bilancia i caratteri a byte singolo e a byte doppio. |
| [getCachedColBalance()](#getCachedColBalance) | Usa le informazioni di paragrafo memorizzate nella cache per l'equilibrio delle colonne. |
| [getConvMailMergeEsc()](#getConvMailMergeEsc) | Considera il delimitatore di citazione backslash come due virgolette. |
| [getDisableOpenTypeFontFormattingFeatures()](#getDisableOpenTypeFontFormattingFeatures) | Specifica di disabilitare le funzionalità di formattazione dei font OpenType. |
| [getDisplayHangulFixedWidth()](#getDisplayHangulFixedWidth) | Usa sempre larghezza fissa per i caratteri Hangul. |
| [getDoNotAutofitConstrainedTables()](#getDoNotAutofitConstrainedTables) | Non adattare automaticamente le tabelle per inserirle accanto a oggetti avvolti. |
| [getDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable()](#getDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable) | Non interrompere le righe della tabella attorno a tabelle fluttuanti. |
| [getDoNotBreakWrappedTables()](#getDoNotBreakWrappedTables) | Non consentire alle tabelle fluttuanti di interrompersi tra le pagine. |
| [getDoNotExpandShiftReturn()](#getDoNotExpandShiftReturn) | Non giustificare le linee che terminano con interruzione di riga morbida. |
| [getDoNotLeaveBackslashAlone()](#getDoNotLeaveBackslashAlone) | Converti il backslash in simbolo Yen quando inserito. |
| [getDoNotSnapToGridInCell()](#getDoNotSnapToGridInCell) | Non agganciare alla griglia del documento nelle celle della tabella con oggetti. |
| [getDoNotSuppressIndentation()](#getDoNotSuppressIndentation) | Non ignorare gli oggetti fluttuanti durante il calcolo dell'indentazione del paragrafo. |
| [getDoNotSuppressParagraphBorders()](#getDoNotSuppressParagraphBorders) | Non sopprimere i bordi del paragrafo accanto ai riquadri. |
| [getDoNotUseEastAsianBreakRules()](#getDoNotUseEastAsianBreakRules) | Non comprimere i caratteri comprimibili quando si utilizza la griglia del documento. |
| [getDoNotUseHTMLParagraphAutoSpacing()](#getDoNotUseHTMLParagraphAutoSpacing) | Usa spaziatura fissa del paragrafo per l'impostazione automatica HTML. |
| [getDoNotUseIndentAsNumberingTabStop()](#getDoNotUseIndentAsNumberingTabStop) | Ignora l'indentazione sospesa quando si crea una tabulazione dopo la numerazione. |
| [getDoNotVertAlignCellWithSp()](#getDoNotVertAlignCellWithSp) | Non allineare verticalmente le celle contenenti oggetti fluttuanti. |
| [getDoNotVertAlignInTxbx()](#getDoNotVertAlignInTxbx) | Ignora l'allineamento verticale nelle caselle di testo. |
| [getDoNotWrapTextWithPunct()](#getDoNotWrapTextWithPunct) | Non consentire punteggiatura sospesa con la griglia dei caratteri. |
| [getFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8()](#getFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8) | Emula il posizionamento delle note a piè di pagina di Word 6.x/95/97. |
| [getForgetLastTabAlignment()](#getForgetLastTabAlignment) | Ignora la larghezza dell'ultima tabulazione quando si allinea il paragrafo se non è allineato a sinistra. |
| [getGrowAutofit()](#getGrowAutofit) | Consenti alle tabelle di adattarsi automaticamente ai margini della pagina. |
| [getLayoutRawTableWidth()](#getLayoutRawTableWidth) | Ignora lo spazio prima della tabella quando si decide se la tabella deve avvolgere l'oggetto fluttuante. |
| [getLayoutTableRowsApart()](#getLayoutTableRowsApart) | Consenti alle righe della tabella di avvolgere gli oggetti in linea in modo indipendente. |
| [getLineWrapLikeWord6()](#getLineWrapLikeWord6) | Emula l'andata a capo delle linee di Word 6.0 per il testo est-asiatico. |
| [getMWSmallCaps()](#getMWSmallCaps) | Emula Word 5.x per il Macintosh per la formattazione Small Caps. |
| [getNoColumnBalance()](#getNoColumnBalance) | Non bilanciare le colonne di testo all'interno di una sezione. |
| [getNoExtraLineSpacing()](#getNoExtraLineSpacing) | Non centrare il contenuto su righe con altezza di linea esatta. |
| [getNoLeading()](#getNoLeading) | Non aggiungere interlinea tra le righe di testo. |
| [getNoSpaceRaiseLower()](#getNoSpaceRaiseLower) | Non aumentare l'altezza di linea per testo rialzato/abbassato. |
| [getNoTabHangInd()](#getNoTabHangInd) | Non creare tabulazione personalizzata per rientro sospeso. |
| [getOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification()](#getOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification) | Specifica come viene valutata la gerarchia degli stili del documento. |
| [getPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader()](#getPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader) | Stampa il testo del corpo prima dei contenuti di intestazione/piè di pagina. |

| [getShapeLayoutLikeWW8()](#getShapeLayoutLikeWW8) | Emula il testo di Word 97 che avvolge gli oggetti fluttuanti. |
| [getShowBreaksInFrames()](#getShowBreaksInFrames) | Visualizza le interruzioni di pagina/colonna presenti nei riquadri. |
| [getSpaceForUL()](#getSpaceForUL) | Aggiungi spazio aggiuntivo sotto la linea di base per il testo asiatico orientale sottolineato. |
| [getSpacingInWholePoints()](#getSpacingInWholePoints) | Espandi/contrae il testo solo di punti interi. |

| [getSwapBordersFacingPgs()](#getSwapBordersFacingPgs) | Scambia i bordi del paragrafo nelle pagine dispari. |

| [setFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8(boolean value)](#setFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8-boolean) | Emula il posizionamento delle note a piè di pagina di Word 6.x/95/97. |
| [setForgetLastTabAlignment(boolean value)](#setForgetLastTabAlignment-boolean) | Ignora la larghezza dell'ultima tabulazione quando si allinea il paragrafo se non è allineato a sinistra. |
| [setGrowAutofit(boolean value)](#setGrowAutofit-boolean) | Consenti alle tabelle di adattarsi automaticamente ai margini della pagina. |
| [setLayoutRawTableWidth(boolean value)](#setLayoutRawTableWidth-boolean) | Ignora lo spazio prima della tabella quando si decide se la tabella deve avvolgere l'oggetto fluttuante. |
| [setLayoutTableRowsApart(boolean value)](#setLayoutTableRowsApart-boolean) | Consenti alle righe della tabella di avvolgere gli oggetti in linea in modo indipendente. |
| [setLineWrapLikeWord6(boolean value)](#setLineWrapLikeWord6-boolean) | Emula l'andata a capo delle linee di Word 6.0 per il testo est-asiatico. |
| [setMWSmallCaps(boolean value)](#setMWSmallCaps-boolean) | Emula Word 5.x per il Macintosh per la formattazione Small Caps. |
| [setNoColumnBalance(boolean value)](#setNoColumnBalance-boolean) | Non bilanciare le colonne di testo all'interno di una sezione. |
| [setNoExtraLineSpacing(boolean value)](#setNoExtraLineSpacing-boolean) | Non centrare il contenuto su righe con altezza di linea esatta. |
| [setNoLeading(boolean value)](#setNoLeading-boolean) | Non aggiungere interlinea tra le righe di testo. |
| [setNoSpaceRaiseLower(boolean value)](#setNoSpaceRaiseLower-boolean) | Non aumentare l'altezza di linea per testo rialzato/abbassato. |
| [setNoTabHangInd(boolean value)](#setNoTabHangInd-boolean) | Non creare tabulazione personalizzata per rientro sospeso. |
| [setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification(boolean value)](#setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification-boolean) | Specifica come viene valutata la gerarchia degli stili del documento. |
| [setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader(boolean value)](#setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader-boolean) | Stampa il testo del corpo prima dei contenuti di intestazione/piè di pagina. |
| [setPrintColBlack(boolean value)](#setPrintColBlack-boolean) | Stampa i colori in bianco e nero senza dithering. |
| [setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar(boolean value)](#setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar-boolean) | Seleziona il campo quando il primo o l'ultimo carattere è selezionato. |
| [setShapeLayoutLikeWW8(boolean value)](#setShapeLayoutLikeWW8-boolean) | Emula il testo di Word 97 che avvolge gli oggetti fluttuanti. |
| [setShowBreaksInFrames(boolean value)](#setShowBreaksInFrames-boolean) | Visualizza le interruzioni di pagina/colonna presenti nei riquadri. |
| [setSpaceForUL(boolean value)](#setSpaceForUL-boolean) | Aggiungi spazio aggiuntivo sotto la linea di base per il testo asiatico orientale sottolineato. |
| [setSpacingInWholePoints(boolean value)](#setSpacingInWholePoints-boolean) | Espandi/contrae il testo solo di punti interi. |
| [setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark(boolean value)](#setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark-boolean) | Sposta sempre il segno di paragrafo alla pagina successiva dopo un'interruzione di pagina. |
| [setSubFontBySize(boolean value)](#setSubFontBySize-boolean) | Aumenta la priorità della dimensione del carattere durante la sostituzione del carattere. |
| [setSuppressBottomSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressBottomSpacing-boolean) | Ignora l'altezza di linea esatta per l'ultima riga della pagina. |
| [setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk-boolean) | Non usare lo spazio prima nella prima riga dopo un'interruzione di pagina. |
| [setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage-boolean) | Ignora l'altezza minima di linea per la prima riga della pagina. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacing-boolean) | Ignora l'altezza minima ed esatta di linea per la prima riga della pagina. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacingWP(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacingWP-boolean) | Emula la spaziatura delle righe di WordPerfect 5.x. |
| [setSwapBordersFacingPgs(boolean value)](#setSwapBordersFacingPgs-boolean) | Scambia i bordi del paragrafo nelle pagine dispari. |
| [setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning(boolean value)](#setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning-boolean) | Specifica di scambiare interno ed esterno per rientri speculari e posizionamento relativo. |
| [setTransparentMetafiles(boolean value)](#setTransparentMetafiles-boolean) | Specifica di non cancellare l'area dietro le immagini metafile. |
| [setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6(boolean value)](#setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6-boolean) | Emula il calcolo dell'altezza del carattere di WordPerfect 6.x. |
| [setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)](#setUICompat97To2003-boolean) | True per disabilitare le funzionalità UI non compatibili con Word97-2003. |
| [setUlTrailSpace(boolean value)](#setUlTrailSpace-boolean) | Sottolinea tutti gli spazi finali. |
| [setUnderlineTabInNumList(boolean value)](#setUnderlineTabInNumList-boolean) | Sottolinea il carattere successivo alla numerazione. |
| [setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules-boolean) | Usa un set alternativo di regole di interruzione di riga per l'Est asiatico. |
| [setUseAnsiKerningPairs(boolean value)](#setUseAnsiKerningPairs-boolean) | Usa coppie di kerning ANSI dai font. |
| [setUseFELayout(boolean value)](#setUseFELayout-boolean) | Non aggirare il codice di layout per l'Est asiatico/script complesso. |
| [setUseNormalStyleForList(boolean value)](#setUseNormalStyleForList-boolean) | Non applicare automaticamente lo stile di paragrafo elenco al testo puntato/numerato. |
| [setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)](#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean) | Usa le metriche della stampante per visualizzare i documenti. |
| [setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells(boolean value)](#setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells-boolean) | Usa regole semplificate per i conflitti dei bordi della tabella. |
| [setUseWord2002TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2002TableStyleRules-boolean) | Emula le regole di stile della tabella di Word 2002. |
| [setUseWord2010TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2010TableStyleRules-boolean) | Specifica di usare le regole di stile della tabella di Word2010. |
| [setUseWord97LineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord97LineBreakRules-boolean) | Emula l'interruzione di riga per l'Est asiatico di Word 97. |
| [setWPJustification(boolean value)](#setWPJustification-boolean) | Emula la giustificazione dei paragrafi di WordPerfect 6.x. |
| [setWPSpaceWidth(boolean value)](#setWPSpaceWidth-boolean) | Specifica se impostare la larghezza di uno spazio come avviene in WordPerfect 5.x. |
| [setWrapTrailSpaces(boolean value)](#setWrapTrailSpaces-boolean) | Interruzione di riga per spazi finali. |
### getAdjustLineHeightInTable() {#getAdjustLineHeightInTable}

```
public boolean getAdjustLineHeightInTable()
```

Aggiungi la spaziatura della griglia del documento alle righe nelle celle della tabella.

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 /// 
 /// Groups all flags in a document's compatibility options object by state, then prints each group.

 {

     addOptionName(options.getWrapTrailSpaces(), "WrapTrailSpaces", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");
     for (String optionName : disabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }
```

```
public boolean getAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell()
```

Consenti alle colonne della tabella di superare le larghezze preferite delle celle costituenti.

L'opzione è chiamata "Use Word 2003 table autofit rules" nell'interfaccia utente di MS Word 2013. Influisce effettivamente su come la griglia è calcolata per le tabelle a layout fisso, anch'essa (in alcuni casi).

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
```

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

### getUICompat97To2003() {#getUICompat97To2003}
```
public boolean getUICompat97To2003()
```


True per disabilitare le funzionalità UI non compatibili con Word97-2003. Il valore predefinito è false.

 **Remarks:** 

Controlla l'impostazione di compatibilità Word97-2003 che disabilita le funzionalità UI non compatibili con Word97-2003. Quando true, l'elemento XML 'w:uiCompat97To2003' viene scritto nella parte del pacchetto documento "\\word\\settings.xml". Il valore predefinito è false. Quando impostato su false, questo elemento non viene scritto. Tecnicamente questa proprietà non fa parte delle opzioni di compatibilità, ma l'abbiamo inserita qui per comodità dell'API.

 **Examples:** 

Mostra come ottimizzare il documento per diverse versioni di Microsoft Word.

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

### getUsePrinterMetrics() {#getUsePrinterMetrics}
```
public boolean getUsePrinterMetrics()
```


Usa le metriche della stampante per visualizzare i documenti.

 **Remarks:** 

Le metriche della stampante possono variare a seconda dei driver utilizzati. Ad esempio, Windows "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" e "Microsoft Print to PDF" forniscono metriche leggermente diverse. Pertanto, il layout del documento finale può cambiare se questa opzione è abilitata.

 **Examples:** 

Mostra come ottimizzare il documento per diverse versioni di Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

### setAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell(boolean value) {#setAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell-boolean}



Consenti alle colonne della tabella di superare le larghezze preferite delle celle costituenti.

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

### setDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable(boolean value) {#setDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable-boolean}

```
public void setDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable(boolean value)
```

Non interrompere le righe della tabella attorno a tabelle fluttuanti.

 **Examples:**

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

 **Examples:**

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
public void setForgetLastTabAlignment(boolean value)
```


Ignora la larghezza dell'ultima tabulazione quando si allinea il paragrafo se non è allineato a sinistra.

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

### setUICompat97To2003(boolean value) {#setUICompat97To2003-boolean}
```
public void setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)
```


True per disabilitare le funzionalità UI non compatibili con Word97-2003. Il valore predefinito è false.

 **Remarks:** 

Controlla l'impostazione di compatibilità Word97-2003 che disabilita le funzionalità UI non compatibili con Word97-2003. Quando true, l'elemento XML 'w:uiCompat97To2003' viene scritto nella parte del pacchetto documento "\\word\\settings.xml". Il valore predefinito è false. Quando impostato su false, questo elemento non viene scritto. Tecnicamente questa proprietà non fa parte delle opzioni di compatibilità, ma l'abbiamo inserita qui per comodità dell'API.

 **Examples:** 

Mostra come ottimizzare il documento per diverse versioni di Microsoft Word.

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

### setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value) {#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean}
```
public void setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)
```


Usa le metriche della stampante per visualizzare i documenti.

 **Remarks:** 

Le metriche della stampante possono variare a seconda dei driver utilizzati. Ad esempio, Windows "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" e "Microsoft Print to PDF" forniscono metriche leggermente diverse. Pertanto, il layout del documento finale può cambiare se questa opzione è abilitata.

 **Examples:** 

Mostra come ottimizzare il documento per diverse versioni di Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     addOptionName(options.getUseWord2010TableStyleRules(), "UseWord2010TableStyleRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseWord97LineBreakRules(), "UseWord97LineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPJustification(), "WPJustification", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPSpaceWidth(), "WPSpaceWidth", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWrapTrailSpaces(), "WrapTrailSpaces", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");
     for (String optionName : disabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }
```
